news.words: James Conner (ankle) suffered a season-ending ankle injury in the Cardinals' loss to the 49ers that will require surgery. The extent of the damage to his ankle is unknown.

Conner was carted off with a right ankle injury. Schefter reports that the injury will require season-ending surgery, though further testing Monday will provide the full extent. Gannon said after the loss he didn't know the severity.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Darren Urban, Cardinals official site)
news.words: Coach Jonathan Gannon said Monday that Conner will undergo season-ending foot surgery.

Cardinals head coach Jonathan Gannon confirmed the team's worst fears and announced that running back James Conner will miss the rest of the season. Gannon says he will undergo surgery and miss the remainder of the 2025 campaign.
Conner suffered a right foot injury, coach Jonathan Gannon said Monday, not the ankle as previously believed. Conner will still have to have surgery and will miss the rest of the season, Gannon said.
